name: start-positioning-statement
description: Writes a Positioning Statement from the five components of positioning, with the honest alternatives including hiring someone or doing it themselves with AI, your capabilities with proof, the value in the client's terms, one line a contact can repeat and a repeat-back test on three people who know you. Use for "run start-positioning-statement", "nobody can explain what I do now", "write my positioning", "elevator pitch for my new practice", "one line about what I do", "why me and not AI", "how do I describe what I do", part of the Claude Guide for New Founders Pack by 90n.
